results.observed_sdk_behaviour: A PNG whose IHDR declares 30000x30000 over invalid data is refused by exr_image_page_dimensions as a damaged header (EXR_FORMAT), not EXR_LIMIT; the first run asserted LIMIT and failed on all three platforms. The check now accepts a refusal status LIMIT or FORMAT before decode and separate valid oversize PNGs assert LIMIT strictly. The SDK also refuses to import an EPUB that declares a cover item whose file is missing, so the cover-less case uses a generated EPUB with no cover item.
